nodes.title: Note: size and Referencen Images
widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 Image doesn't work well in low resolution, so this workflow upscale the input image to 4MP at first.

## Recommended sizes (16MP)

The effective working range of MiniMax-H3-Image is about 4 MP to 20 MP, and it generally gives
the best results at around 16 MP. Common 16 MP sizes are listed below:

| Aspect ratio | Size (width x height) |
| --- | --- |
| 1:1 | 4096x4096 |
| 4:3 / 3:4 | 4736x3552 / 3552x4736 |
| 3:2 / 2:3 | 5024x3360 / 3360x5024 |
| 16:9 / 9:16 | 5472x3072 / 3072x5472 |
| 21:9 | 6272x2688 |

## Multiple image editing

If you want to use multiple image editing:
- add extra `Load Image` nodes
- plug the output to both `Generate Text` 👇 and `MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning`👆 nodes

## Input Asset

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face:Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (21 GB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) (25.28 GB)
- [qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors) (6.84 GB)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│       └── minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values: Reason in the thinking section first. The visible final content must be exactly one JSON object with exactly two keys: expanded_caption and aspect_ratio. Every ASCII double quotation mark used as caption content inside expanded_caption must be serialized as the JSON escape sequence \". Do not output text outside that object.

nodes.title: Note: PE model
widgets_values:
For MiniMax H3 Image's PE model it’s not tied to any specific model

[MiniMax H3 Image PE](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image-PE) repo is using `Qwen3.8-27B, FP4` and we are using Qwen3.5 9B in this workflow
